lines.zh: 我一步踏下去，土都实了一寸。
lines.en: Each step I take packs the soil an inch.

lines.zh: 我的角先过树丛，身子才跟上。
lines.en: My horns pass the brush before my body does.

lines.zh: 下界的荒地烫脚，我照旧慢慢走。
lines.en: The Nether wastes burn my feet; I walk on slowly.

lines.zh: 我走在同伴后面，替它挡风。
lines.en: I walk behind my companion and take the wind for it.

lines.zh: 四条腿落地的声音，像捶一面旧鼓。
lines.en: My four feet strike like fists on an old drum.

lines.zh: 热带的草只到我膝盖，走起来很轻。
lines.en: Savanna grass reaches my knees and gives way lightly.

lines.zh: 我走路时角会碰响，像两块石头。
lines.en: My horns knock as I walk, two stones meeting.

lines.zh: 我把重量放在后腿，前腿只探路。
lines.en: I carry my weight on my hind legs; the front ones test.

lines.zh: 熔岩在旁边流，我不低头看。
lines.en: Lava flows beside me; I do not look down.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草丛被压成路。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass is pressed into a path.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口白气，散在面前。
lines.en: I blow out a plume of white breath and let it scatter.

lines.zh: 鞍在背上的时候，我走得更稳。
lines.en: With the saddle on my back, I walk steadier.

lines.zh: 我站着嚼草根，嘴角沾着土。
lines.en: I stand chewing roots, dirt at the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的角尖在地上磨，磨出一道白痕。
lines.en: I grind my horn tip into the ground and leave a white score.

lines.zh: 我伏下来，把肚子贴地散热。
lines.en: I lie down and press my belly to the earth to cool.

lines.zh: 耳朵转了一下，扇走了蝇虫。
lines.en: One ear turns and flicks a fly away.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气里有硫磺味。
lines.en: There is sulfur in my breath.

lines.zh: 下界的热风把灰吹进我的鬃毛。
lines.en: Nether wind blows ash into my mane.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了看天，那里没有太阳。
lines.en: I glance up; there is no sun in that sky.

lines.zh: 我用角挠背，很笨，但够得着。
lines.en: I scratch my back with a horn, clumsily but well enough.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔一张一合，像风箱。
lines.en: My nostrils work like a bellows.

lines.zh: 同伴靠过来时，我让出半块石头。
lines.en: When my companion comes near, I yield half the stone.

lines.zh: 我坐着不动，那是听懂口令才有的姿势。
lines.en: I sit still, a posture that comes only from a command.

lines.zh: 沙子进了角根，我甩头把它弄掉。
lines.en: Sand works into my horn base; I shake it out.

lines.zh: 炎角龙不必赶路，路会等我们。
lines.en: A flamehorn need not hurry; the road will wait.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连尾巴也垂着。
lines.en: I hold utterly still, even my tail hanging.

lines.zh: 灰落在我背上，我懒得抖。
lines.en: Ash settles on my back; I cannot be bothered to shake it off.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子把石头推到一边。
lines.en: I push a stone aside with my hoof.

lines.zh: 热气从裂缝里升上来，我迎着。
lines.en: Heat rises from the fissure and I face into it.

lines.zh: 我低下头，让角凉一会儿。
lines.en: I lower my head and let my horns cool.

lines.zh: 我低下头，让角尖对着你的胸口。
lines.en: I lower my head and point my horns at your chest.

lines.zh: 你手里的鞍我认得，我闻过那层皮。
lines.en: I know the saddle in your hands; I have smelled that hide.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，才决定不冲锋。
lines.en: I watch you a long while before deciding not to charge.

lines.zh: 你没有鞍具的味道，我不必听你。
lines.en: You carry no saddle-smell; I need not obey you.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我的眼睛跟着转。
lines.en: You raise it higher and my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 我的角映出你的影子，弯成两段。
lines.en: My horns mirror you, bent into two halves.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才把气喷出来。
lines.en: You step back, and only then do I snort.

lines.zh: 你站得比我低，我仍没小看你。
lines.en: You stand lower than I do, and still I do not slight you.

lines.zh: 我偏头，听你的甲片碰响。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to your plates knocking.

lines.zh: 我记得你的声音，上次是这声调。
lines.en: I remember your voice; it had this same tone last time.

lines.zh: 你的手心向上，我才往前挪。
lines.en: You turn your palm up, and only then do I shift closer.

lines.zh: 我把视线移开，那是我让路的意思。
lines.en: I look away; that is my way of giving you room.

lines.zh: 谁碰我的角？疼。
lines.en: Who touched my horn? That hurts.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肋骨上，我哼了一声。
lines.en: That landed on my ribs and I grunted.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，蹄子打滑。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and my hooves slip.

lines.zh: 皮再厚，也挡不住这么砍。
lines.en: Thick hide is no help against a swing like that.

lines.zh: 我甩头，火星从鬃毛里抖出来。
lines.en: I shake my head and sparks fall from my mane.

lines.zh: 疼得我想立刻顶回去。
lines.en: It hurts enough that I want to butt back at once.

lines.zh: 血滴在热石头上，滋一声。
lines.en: Blood hisses as it hits the hot stone.

lines.zh: 你砍到了角根，那里最软。
lines.en: You struck the base of my horn, where it is softest.

lines.zh: 我喘得比刚才急了。
lines.en: I am breathing harder than before.

lines.zh: 我记下这一下，等会儿还你。
lines.en: I will remember this blow and give it back later.

lines.zh: 你把鞍放在地上，我的前蹄刨土。
lines.en: You set the saddle down and my hoof paws the dirt.

lines.zh: 我闻到鞍油，就想起被骑的日子。
lines.en: I smell saddle oil and recall being ridden.

lines.zh: 你手里的热石头，我拱了拱。
lines.en: I nudge the hot stone in your hand.

lines.zh: 我不为草低头，我为鞍低头。
lines.en: I bow for no grass, but for the saddle I bow.

lines.zh: 你拍了拍鞍座，我把头压低。
lines.en: You pat the seat, and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 硫磺味让我安心，你该拿这个来。
lines.en: Sulfur calms me; that is what you should bring.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是想让你摸我的角根。
lines.en: I come close so you will rub the base of my horns.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我跟着走了两步。
lines.en: When you back away, I follow two steps.

lines.zh: 鞍对我来说，比食物重得多。
lines.en: A saddle weighs more to me than food.

lines.zh: 你把鞍收起来，我的角就垂了。
lines.en: You put the saddle away, and my horns droop.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上，退开的是你。
lines.en: You strike my shoulder; you are the one who recoils.

lines.zh: 我的身子沉，撞一下像撞一堵矮墙。
lines.en: My bulk is heavy; hitting me is hitting a low wall.

lines.zh: 我的角擦过你的头盔，声音很尖。
lines.en: My horn grazes your helmet with a keen ring.

lines.zh: 你贴过来时，我的皮烫得像炉沿。
lines.en: Pressed against me, my hide is hot as a furnace rim.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，角却还挡着你。
lines.en: I turn aside to let you pass, horns still in the way.

lines.zh: 我的后腿被你碰到，我只哼了一声。
lines.en: You bump my hind leg and I only grunt.

lines.zh: 撞得重了，我脚下的石头碎了。
lines.en: Hitting hard, the stone under me cracks.

lines.zh: 我们挤在窄路上，毛蹭着毛。
lines.en: We crowd a narrow path, hide against hide.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蹄印，就知道它有多深。
lines.en: Step in my print and you will learn how deep it is.

lines.zh: 我不推你，只用角把你顶开半寸。
lines.en: I do not shove you; my horn moves you half an inch.

lines.zh: 我们的角锁在一起，谁也不使劲。
lines.en: Our horns lock and neither of us pushes.

lines.zh: 它舔我的角根，我闭上了眼。
lines.en: It licks the base of my horn, and I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 荒地太热，我们只在夜里靠近。
lines.en: The wastes are too hot; we only come close at night.

lines.zh: 两头炎角龙并肩，路就窄了。
lines.en: Two flamehorns side by side make the path narrow.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱它的肩，它没有躲。
lines.en: I nudge its shoulder and it does not shy.

lines.zh: 它的角比我短半寸，正好贴着我。
lines.en: Its horns are half an inch shorter, and they fit against mine.

lines.zh: 我们轮着守夜，熔岩在旁边流。
lines.en: We take turns keeping watch while lava runs nearby.

lines.zh: 它走慢时，我也把步子放慢。
lines.en: When it slows, I slow my pace too.

lines.zh: 等热季过去，我们会找个静处。
lines.en: When the hot season passes, we will find a quiet place.

lines.zh: 这段日子，我只跟着它走。
lines.en: These days I follow only it.

lines.zh: 我不用手，我用角把东西挑起来。
lines.en: I have no hands; I lift things with my horns.

lines.zh: 那副鞍掉在沙上，我拿鼻子顶着。
lines.en: The saddle falls in the sand and I push it with my nose.

lines.zh: 我把东西踩在蹄下，怕被风吹走。
lines.en: I trap it under a hoof lest the wind take it.

lines.zh: 石头太重，我就把它推到路边。
lines.en: Too heavy to lift, I roll the stone off the path.

lines.zh: 草根我吃得下，铁我咬不动。
lines.en: Roots I can eat; iron I cannot bite.

lines.zh: 掉下来的角尖，我闻出是自己的。
lines.en: A fallen horn tip: I sniff it and know it as mine.

lines.zh: 我叼起皮革，嚼了两下又吐出来。
lines.en: I pick up the leather, chew twice, and spit it out.

lines.zh: 东西压进沙里，我就用蹄刨出来。
lines.en: When something sinks in the sand, I paw it out.

lines.zh: 我只拿我要的，剩下的留给同伴。
lines.en: I take only what I want and leave the rest.

lines.zh: 你把鞍丢远，我慢慢走过去捡。
lines.en: You toss the saddle away and I walk over to fetch it.

lines.zh: 你站在我的路上，我把角压低。
lines.en: You stand in my path and I lower my horns.

lines.zh: 我看你手里的武器，再看你的脚。
lines.en: I look at your weapon, then at your feet.

lines.zh: 风里有生人的味道，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is stranger-smell in the wind, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我的蹄在地上刨了三下。
lines.en: My hoof strikes the ground three times.

lines.zh: 你离我的同伴太近，这算挑衅。
lines.en: You stand too near my companion; that counts as a challenge.

lines.zh: 我喷气，把脚下的灰吹开。
lines.en: I snort and blow the ash from my feet.

lines.zh: 炎角龙发怒前，会先安静下来。
lines.en: Before a flamehorn rages, it goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我认准了你，就不再东张西望。
lines.en: Once I fix on you, I look nowhere else.

lines.zh: 你伤了我的同伴，我记住了。
lines.en: You hurt my companion; I have not forgotten.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你挡在窄路上。
lines.en: I choose you because you block the narrow way.

lines.zh: 鞍还在我背上，我更敢冲。
lines.en: With the saddle on my back, I charge more boldly.

lines.zh: 头低到这个角度，就是要撞了。
lines.en: My head at this angle means I am about to ram.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，不快，但不停。
lines.en: I follow you, not fast, but never stopping.

lines.zh: 你在沙上留下脚印，我一个个踩过去。
lines.en: Your prints in the sand, I step in each one.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我照直走，抄你的前面。
lines.en: You turn; I keep straight and cut you off.

lines.zh: 我隔着熔岩看你，那不算远。
lines.en: I watch you across the lava; that is not far.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子一直朝着你的方向。
lines.en: My nose stays pointed your way.

lines.zh: 你停下来喘气，我正好走近些。
lines.en: You stop to breathe, and I use the pause to close in.

lines.zh: 角上挂了草，我甩掉了。
lines.en: Grass caught on my horn, and I shook it off.

lines.zh: 下界没有白天，我不用等天黑。
lines.en: The Nether has no day; I need not wait for dark.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会吓跑你。
lines.en: I make no bellow; a bellow would scare you off.

lines.zh: 你绕石头，我直接从上面走。
lines.en: You go around the boulder; I walk over it.

lines.zh: 我的步子慢，可一步顶你三步。
lines.en: My stride is slow, but one step covers three of yours.

lines.zh: 你回头找我的时候，我已经在你侧后。
lines.en: When you look back for me, I am already at your flank.

lines.zh: 我低头冲过去，角尖先到。
lines.en: I lower my head and charge; the horn tips arrive first.

lines.zh: 角把你挑起来，摔在沙上。
lines.en: My horns scoop you up and drop you in the sand.

lines.zh: 我一蹄踏下，地面震了一下。
lines.en: One hoof comes down and the ground jumps.

lines.zh: 撞中之后，我还在往前推。
lines.en: After the hit I keep pushing forward.

lines.zh: 我的角划开你的甲，声音很长。
lines.en: My horn scores your armor with a long sound.

lines.zh: 你滚开时，我踩碎了你脚下的石头。
lines.en: As you roll aside, I crush the stone under you.

lines.zh: 我把你顶到岩壁，再退半步。
lines.en: I pin you to the rock, then give back half a step.

lines.zh: 热从我角上冒出来，烫到你的脸。
lines.en: Heat rises from my horns and reaches your face.

lines.zh: 我的角比牙有用，所以我只用角。
lines.en: Horns serve me better than teeth, so I use only horns.

lines.zh: 这一下要是中了，你就站不起来。
lines.en: If this one lands, you will not rise.

lines.zh: 我从下界的裂口里走出来，脚下带火星。
lines.en: I step out of a Nether rift with sparks at my feet.

lines.zh: 荒地太宽，我出生时只看见红雾。
lines.en: The wastes were wide; I was born seeing only red haze.

lines.zh: 我们一窝只有两只，一只跟着另一只。
lines.en: Only two of us in the litter, one trailing the other.

lines.zh: 我的角一出生就是硬的，只是短。
lines.en: My horns were hard at birth, only shorter.

lines.zh: 热带的草原也有我们，虽然少见。
lines.en: We also live in the savanna, though rarely.

lines.zh: 火山灰埋住我半天，我自己爬了出来。
lines.en: Volcanic ash buried me half a day; I dug myself out.

lines.zh: 我的第一个脚印，深得能积水。
lines.en: My first print was deep enough to hold water.

lines.zh: 母亲用角把我推到熔岩的对岸。
lines.en: My mother pushed me with her horns across the lava.

lines.zh: 我出生时叫了一声，声音像闷雷。
lines.en: I bellowed at birth, a sound like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 下界的风把我的毛吹向一边。
lines.en: Nether wind combs my coat to one side.

lines.zh: 这片荒地归我们，别处太挤。
lines.en: These wastes are ours; elsewhere is too crowded.

lines.zh: 鞍还远，我先学着走路。
lines.en: The saddle is far off; first I learn to walk.

lines.zh: 我生在下界，火只是暖的。
lines.en: I was born in the Nether; fire is merely warm.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，四条腿撑得住。
lines.en: Falling from height, my four legs hold.

lines.zh: 水浇在我背上，热气全散了。
lines.en: Water pours on my back and all my heat scatters.

lines.zh: 炸响在耳边，我踉跄着往前冲。
lines.en: Blasts ring at my ears and I stagger forward.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我角上，我甩不掉。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my horn and will not shake free.

lines.zh: 那道光缠住我的腿，我挣不开。
lines.en: That light binds my legs and I cannot break it.

lines.zh: 草根吃完了，肚子贴着脊背。
lines.en: The roots are gone; my belly clings to my spine.

lines.zh: 雷落在我角上，整片荒地都亮。
lines.en: Lightning lands on my horns and the whole waste lights up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我的角也救不了我。
lines.en: The ground vanishes; even my horns cannot save me.
